full_response:
Hello! Main **LawPilot AI** hoon, India me sabhi major legal matters ke liye aapka comprehensive legal assistant.

Main Indian law ke sabhi areas me aapki madad karta hoon:
- 🏠 Property, RERA & Tenancy (deposit refund, eviction protection, possession delays)
- ⚖️ Criminal Law (BNS/BNSS/BSA 2023, FIR, bail, fraud)
- 🛒 Consumer Protection (defective items, refund issues, e-commerce grievances)
- 💼 Employment & Wages (unpaid salary, FnF settlement, relieving letter)
- 💳 Banking & Cyber (online fraud, account freeze, cheque bounce 138)
- 📜 Family, Civil, Tax & RTI (divorce, maintenance, civil recovery, IT notice, RTI)

Aap apni situation simple English, Hindi ya Hinglish me batayein — main poori legal guidance dunga.
